name: Diffusion 3D Molecular Generation Benchmark
description: An evaluation suite and comparative benchmark study measuring performance of diffusion-based 3D molecular generation models.
reputation: Moderately used within computational chemistry research for evaluating 3D diffusion-based molecular generators; adoption is growing but it is less widely used than established 2D molecule benchmarks.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on 3D molecular generation; reported metrics are typically composite (validity, uniqueness, novelty, RMSD, property matching). Results can be sensitive to dataset size and pretraining contamination; metrics such as docking scores or RMSD do not guarantee synthesizability or biological activity.
